title: China-to-South Korea Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: KC Safety Certification and KS C IEC 62841 Electrical Safety
rows.target_requirement: Electric power tools placed on the Korean market fall under the Electrical Appliances and Consumer Products Safety Control Act administered by KATS under MOTIE, and most motor-operated hand-held tools require KC Safety Certification before sale. The applicable electrical safety standard is the KS C IEC 62841 series transposing IEC 62841 for hand-held, transportable, and lawn and garden tools. Testing is performed by designated Korean labs such as KTC, KTL, or KTR, and the charger or external power supply of a cordless tool is assessed under its own KC scope. Korea operates on a 220 V, 60 Hz grid, so designs validated for China's 220 V, 50 Hz supply must be re-evaluated for 60 Hz operation.
target_standards: Electrical Appliances and Consumer Products Safety Control Act (KATS / MOTIE)
KC Safety Certification (mandatory for in-scope motor-operated tools)
KS C IEC 62841 series (electrical safety for hand-held, transportable, and lawn and garden tools)
Designated test labs: KTC, KTL, KTR
Separate KC scope for the charger or external power supply where applicable
rows.china_equivalent: China files commonly use the GB/T 3883 series for tool electrical safety and CCC certification where the product falls within a CCC catalogue scope, with separate standards for the charger where applicable. These reports demonstrate China domestic conformity and must be re-mapped to KS C IEC 62841 clauses and KC certification rather than treated as automatic KC evidence, with particular attention to the 50 Hz versus 60 Hz supply difference.
china_standards: CCC certification where within catalogue scope
China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: The common gap is presenting GB/T 3883 reports or CCC certificates as sufficient for Korea, when KC Safety Certification requires testing to KS C IEC 62841 at a Korean designated lab and a Korea-specific certificate. Exporters also overlook that the tool is validated for 50 Hz in China but Korea is a 60 Hz market, and that the charger needs its own KC coverage.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: KC Safety Certification under the Electrical Appliances and Consumer Products Safety Control Act, with electrical safety demonstrated to the KS C IEC 62841 series for in-scope hand-held and transportable tools; an in-scope charger or external power supply requires its own KC coverage.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：依据《电气用品及生活用品安全管理法》取得 KC 安全认证，并按 KS C IEC 62841 系列证明适用范围内手持及可携式工具的电气安全；适用范围内的充电器或外置电源需要自身的 KC 覆盖。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：依據《電氣用品及生活用品安全管理法》取得 KC 安全認證，並按 KS C IEC 62841 系列證明適用範圍內手持及可攜式工具的電氣安全；適用範圍內的充電器或外置電源需要自身的 KC 覆蓋。

cn.en: China domestic evidence commonly uses the GB/T 3883 series and CCC certification where within catalogue scope, plus charger-specific standards where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内证据通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列及目录范围内的 CCC 认证，并在适用时采用充电器专项标准。
cn.zht: 中國境內證據通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列及目錄範圍內的 CCC 認證，並在適用時採用充電器專項標準。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally non-compliant until the tool holds a valid KC Safety Certification with KS C IEC 62841 testing at a Korean designated lab, the 50 Hz to 60 Hz supply difference is addressed, and any charger or external power supply carries its own KC coverage. GB/T 3883 reports or CCC certificates alone do not establish KC conformity.

source.publisher: Korean Agency for Technology and Standards (KATS), MOTIE

rows.target_requirement: Electromagnetic compatibility for power tools in Korea is handled under the KC-EMC regime administered by the National Radio Research Agency (RRA), which is separate from the KC Safety Certification issued under KATS. Motor-operated tools are typically subject to electromagnetic conformity registration covering emission and immunity, based on KS standards aligned to the CISPR and IEC EMC families. Cordless tools that contain a wireless module additionally trigger radio-equipment conformity through RRA. EMC registration uses test data from a recognised lab and a separate KC-EMC certificate or registration distinct from the safety mark.
target_standards: KC-EMC registration administered by the National Radio Research Agency (RRA)
KS EMC standards aligned to the CISPR and IEC 61000 families (emission and immunity)
Radio Waves Act for wireless modules in cordless tools
Recognised EMC test data from a designated lab
rows.china_equivalent: China files commonly demonstrate EMC through the GB 4343 and GB/T 18595 series for household and similar electric tools, often packaged within CCC where applicable. These reports show China domestic EMC conformity and must be re-mapped to Korean KC-EMC registration via RRA, and any wireless module needs separate Korean radio conformity rather than reliance on the China radio approval.
china_standards: GB 4343 series (EMC for household and similar electric tools)
rows.gap: The common gap is treating KC Safety Certification as covering EMC, when emissions and immunity are registered separately under KC-EMC via RRA. Exporters also reuse China GB 4343 reports without re-testing or mapping to Korean KS EMC standards, and overlook that a wireless module in a cordless tool needs its own Korean radio conformity.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: KC-EMC registration via the RRA for in-scope motor-operated tools, demonstrating emission and immunity to applicable KS EMC standards; a wireless module additionally requires Korean radio-equipment conformity under the Radio Waves Act.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：适用范围内电机驱动工具须经 RRA 完成 KC-EMC 登记，按适用 KS EMC 标准证明发射与抗扰度；无线模块还须依据《电波法》取得韩国无线电设备符合性。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：適用範圍內電機驅動工具須經 RRA 完成 KC-EMC 登記，按適用 KS EMC 標準證明發射與抗擾度；無線模組還須依據《電波法》取得韓國無線電設備符合性。

cn.en: China domestic evidence commonly uses the GB 4343 and GB/T 18595 series, packaged within CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内证据通常采用 GB 4343 及 GB/T 18595 系列，并在适用时纳入 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內證據通常採用 GB 4343 及 GB/T 18595 系列，並在適用時納入 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally non-compliant until the tool carries a valid KC-EMC registration via RRA based on Korean KS EMC test data, separate from the KC safety mark, and any wireless module holds its own Korean radio conformity. China GB 4343 reports alone do not establish KC-EMC conformity.

rows.requirement: KC Mark, Importer Obligations, and Market Access
rows.target_requirement: Placing a power tool on the Korean market requires affixing the KC Mark and meeting labelling, importer-registration, and document-retention duties under the Electrical Appliances and Consumer Products Safety Control Act administered by KATS under MOTIE. The KC safety certificate, the KC-EMC registration, Korean-language safety markings, and importer or representative details must be in place before customs clearance at ports such as Busan or Incheon. Energy efficiency grade labelling via KEA and KEMCO applies where the product type is listed, and the importer of record carries ongoing market-surveillance and recall accountability.
target_standards: Electrical Appliances and Consumer Products Safety Control Act (KATS / MOTIE)
KC Mark affixing and Korean-language labelling obligations
Importer registration and document retention
Energy efficiency grade labelling via KEA / KEMCO where the product type is listed
Customs clearance at ports of Busan and Incheon
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic market access relies on the CCC mark where the product is in catalogue scope, plus China labelling and nameplate rules in Chinese. These satisfy China placing-on-market duties but do not substitute for the KC Mark, Korean-language safety markings, Korean importer registration, or Korea energy-efficiency labelling where applicable.
china_standards: CCC mark where within catalogue scope
China labelling and nameplate rules (Chinese language)
rows.gap: The common gap is shipping with only a CCC mark and Chinese labelling, with no KC Mark, no Korean-language safety markings, and no registered Korean importer of record, which stops customs clearance. Exporters also overlook energy-efficiency grade labelling via KEA and KEMCO where the product is a listed type.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: KC Mark, Korean-language safety labelling, importer registration, and document retention under the Electrical Appliances and Consumer Products Safety Control Act before market placement and customs clearance; energy efficiency grade labelling via KEA and KEMCO is mandatory for listed product types.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：在投放市场及清关前，依据《电气用品及生活用品安全管理法》取得 KC 标志、韩文安全标识、进口商登记及文件保存；列名产品类型须经 KEA 与 KEMCO 进行能效等级标识。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：在投放市場及清關前，依據《電氣用品及生活用品安全管理法》取得 KC 標誌、韓文安全標識、進口商登記及文件保存；列名產品類型須經 KEA 與 KEMCO 進行能效等級標識。

cn.en: China domestic placing-on-market relies on the CCC mark where within catalogue scope and Chinese-language labelling and nameplate rules.
cn.zh: 中国境内投放市场在目录范围内依赖 CCC 标志及中文标识与铭牌规则。
cn.zht: 中國境內投放市場在目錄範圍內依賴 CCC 標誌及中文標識與銘牌規則。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally non-compliant for market placement until the product bears the KC Mark with Korean-language safety markings, a registered Korean importer of record is in place, documents are retained, and energy-efficiency labelling via KEA and KEMCO is applied where the type is listed. A CCC mark and Chinese labelling do not authorise Korean market placement.

source.publisher: Korean Agency for Technology and Standards (KATS), MOTIE

rows.requirement: Noise: No Korean Outdoor-Noise Product-Marking Scheme
rows.target_requirement: South Korea does not operate an EU-style outdoor-noise product-marking regime equivalent to Directive 2000/14/EC, so there is no mandatory guaranteed-sound-power-level marking on the tool as a product-placement condition. Noise is instead governed at the operational and workplace level through the Noise and Vibration Control Act and occupational safety rules administered by the Ministry of Environment and labour authorities, which apply to use, sites, and worker exposure rather than to a CE-style noise label on the equipment. Manufacturers may still declare noise emission data voluntarily or to meet a customer specification, but a Korean noise product marking is not a market-access requirement for power tools.
target_standards: No EU 2000/14/EC-equivalent outdoor-noise product marking in Korea
Noise and Vibration Control Act (operational and site-level noise, Ministry of Environment)
Occupational safety rules on worker noise exposure (labour authorities)
Voluntary manufacturer noise-emission declaration where used
rows.china_equivalent: China addresses tool noise mainly through GB/T product noise test methods and workplace and environmental noise limits rather than an EU-style guaranteed-sound-power product label. As with Korea, China has no obligation to mark a guaranteed sound power level on the tool for market placement, so the China baseline and the Korea position are broadly aligned in not requiring a product noise marking.
china_standards: GB/T product noise test methods for electric tools
China workplace and environmental noise limits
rows.gap: There is no product-marking gap to close for Korea because no outdoor-noise product marking exists, unlike the EU. The practical point for a Chinese exporter is the opposite of the EU lane: do not assume an EU CE noise label is needed for Korea, but be ready to supply voluntary noise-emission data if a Korean buyer or site specifies it, and respect operational noise limits at the place of use.

target.en: Not a mandatory product-marking obligation: Korea has no EU 2000/14/EC-equivalent outdoor-noise product marking for power tools. Operational and workplace noise is regulated under the Noise and Vibration Control Act and occupational safety rules at the use and site level, not as a condition of placing the tool on the market.
target.zh: 非强制产品标识义务：韩国对电动工具并无等同于欧盟 2000/14/EC 的户外噪声产品标识。运行与工作场所噪声依《噪声与振动管理法》及职业安全规则在使用及场所层面管控，而非作为投放市场的条件。
target.zht: 非強制產品標識義務：韓國對電動工具並無等同於歐盟 2000/14/EC 的戶外噪聲產品標識。運行與工作場所噪聲依《噪聲與振動管理法》及職業安全規則在使用及場所層面管控，而非作為投放市場的條件。

cn.en: Not a mandatory product-marking obligation in China either; tool noise is handled via GB/T test methods and workplace and environmental noise limits.
cn.zh: 在中国同样非强制产品标识义务；工具噪声通过 GB/T 测试方法及工作场所与环境噪声限值处理。
cn.zht: 在中國同樣非強制產品標識義務；工具噪聲通過 GB/T 測試方法及工作場所與環境噪聲限值處理。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No product-marking non-compliance arises for Korea because no EU-style outdoor-noise product marking exists for power tools. Treat noise as an operational and workplace matter under the Noise and Vibration Control Act, supply voluntary emission data only where a buyer or site requires it, and do not transfer the EU 2000/14/EC noise label to the Korea lane.

source.publisher: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation (Korea Law Translation, Noise and Vibration Control Act)

rows.target_requirement: Korea controls hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment under the Act on Resource Circulation of EEE and Vehicles, which restricts substances such as lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, and the listed brominated flame retardants in a manner equivalent to EU RoHS. In-scope products must keep technical documentation and a self-declaration demonstrating that restricted-substance limits are met, and the obligation extends to packaging marking and end-of-life and recycling duties. The substance restriction applies independently of the KC safety and KC-EMC routes.
target_standards: Act on Resource Circulation of Electrical and Electronic Equipment and Vehicles (RoHS-equivalent)
Restriction of lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, and listed brominated flame retardants
Technical documentation and self-declaration of restricted-substance compliance
Packaging marking and end-of-life and recycling duties
rows.china_equivalent: China controls these substances under China RoHS, the Administrative Measures for the Restriction of Hazardous Substances in Electrical and Electronic Products, with GB/T 26572 limits and the GB/T 26125 test method, plus the orange or green marking and the Environmental Protection Use Period. These reports demonstrate China conformity but must be re-mapped to the Korean Act on Resource Circulation declaration rather than treated as automatic Korean evidence.
china_standards: China RoHS (Administrative Measures for the Restriction of Hazardous Substances in EEE)
rows.gap: The common gap is relying on China RoHS marking and GB/T 26572 reports without preparing a Korean self-declaration and technical file under the Act on Resource Circulation, and overlooking the Korean packaging marking and recycling duties. The substance data largely overlaps, but the declaration, documentation owner, and recycling obligations are Korea-specific.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: restricted-substance compliance, self-declaration, and technical documentation under the Act on Resource Circulation of EEE and Vehicles, with associated packaging marking and end-of-life and recycling duties for in-scope products.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：依据《电气电子产品及汽车资源循环法》进行限用物质符合性、自我声明及技术文件，并对适用范围内产品履行相关包装标识及报废与回收责任。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：依據《電氣電子產品及汽車資源循環法》進行限用物質符合性、自我聲明及技術文件，並對適用範圍內產品履行相關包裝標識及報廢與回收責任。

cn.en: China domestic evidence commonly uses China RoHS with GB/T 26572 limits, the GB/T 26125 test method, and the corresponding marking and Environmental Protection Use Period.
cn.zh: 中国境内证据通常采用中国 RoHS，配 GB/T 26572 限值、GB/T 26125 测试方法及相应标识与环保使用期限。
cn.zht: 中國境內證據通常採用中國 RoHS，配 GB/T 26572 限值、GB/T 26125 測試方法及相應標識與環保使用期限。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally non-compliant until a Korean self-declaration and technical file under the Act on Resource Circulation are prepared, restricted-substance limits are demonstrated against the Korean list, and packaging marking and recycling duties are met. China RoHS reports and marking alone do not establish Korean conformity.

source.publisher: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation (Act on Resource Circulation of EEE and Vehicles)

rows.target_requirement: Cordless power tools using lithium-ion battery packs are subject to mandatory KC certification of the secondary cells and packs under the Electrical Appliances and Consumer Products Safety Control Act, with safety demonstrated to KC 62133 transposing IEC 62133 for portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries. The certification covers cell and pack electrical, mechanical, and thermal abuse tests, and the battery KC is separate from the tool safety KC and from the charger. Manufacturers must hold the battery KC certificate and the matching factory and conformity documentation before the cordless tool can be placed on the Korean market.
target_standards: Electrical Appliances and Consumer Products Safety Control Act (KATS / MOTIE)
KC 62133 (portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries, transposing IEC 62133)
Mandatory KC certification of cells and battery packs
Separate from the tool safety KC and the charger KC
rows.china_equivalent: China commonly uses GB 31241 for portable electronic-product lithium batteries and GB/T 18287 or related cell standards, with CCC where the battery type is in catalogue scope. These reports show China conformity but must be re-mapped to KC 62133 and a Korean battery KC certificate, since China test reports are not automatically accepted as KC evidence.
china_standards: GB 31241 (lithium batteries for portable electronic products)
GB/T 18287 or related lithium cell standards
CCC where the battery type is within catalogue scope
rows.gap: The common gap is shipping a cordless tool with only a China GB 31241 battery report or CCC, and no Korean KC 62133 battery certificate. Exporters also bundle the battery into the tool safety file instead of holding a separate battery KC, and overlook that the cells, the pack, and the charger are each assessed under their own KC scope.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: KC certification of lithium cells and battery packs to KC 62133 under the Electrical Appliances and Consumer Products Safety Control Act, held separately from the tool safety KC and the charger KC, before a cordless tool is placed on the Korean market.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：在无绳工具投放韩国市场前，依据《电气用品及生活用品安全管理法》对锂电芯及电池组按 KC 62133 取得 KC 认证，并与工具安全 KC 及充电器 KC 分别持有。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：在無繩工具投放韓國市場前，依據《電氣用品及生活用品安全管理法》對鋰電芯及電池組按 KC 62133 取得 KC 認證，並與工具安全 KC 及充電器 KC 分別持有。

cn.en: China domestic evidence commonly uses GB 31241 and GB/T 18287 or related cell standards, with CCC where the battery type is within catalogue scope.
cn.zh: 中国境内证据通常采用 GB 31241 及 GB/T 18287 或相关电芯标准，并在电池类型属目录范围时取得 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內證據通常採用 GB 31241 及 GB/T 18287 或相關電芯標準，並在電池類型屬目錄範圍時取得 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally non-compliant until the lithium cells and battery packs hold a valid Korean KC 62133 certificate, separate from the tool safety KC and the charger KC, with matching factory and conformity documentation. China GB 31241 reports or CCC alone do not establish Korean battery KC conformity.

source.publisher: Korean Agency for Technology and Standards (KATS), MOTIE
